summary_1line: Bhishma recounts the debate between King Janaka and the yogini Sulabha on true emancipation, knowledge, renunciation, and the nature of self and perception.

image_candidates.scene_text: The yogini Sulabha, radiant and serene, sits before King Janaka in the crowded court of Mithila after mystically entering his mind through yogic power.
Invisible in subtle form, Sulabha and Janaka confront each other in a mental realm while their physical bodies remain seated in the royal court.
Sulabha calmly addresses the king and his gathered Brahmanas, explaining the nature of speech, senses, mind, and the many principles composing the body.
